title: PoopSky
description: Introducing revolutionary pooping functionality to your Minecraft!
body:
# POOPSKY

Introducing revolutionary pooping functionality to your Minecraft!

Note: This mod includes its own skyblock generator. Enable it in the config file, and select the world type "Air Toilet" when creating a new world.


# 🚽 Basic Features

✦Toilet – Players automatically defecate when sneaking on this block.

✦Poop – Works like Bone Meal, but has additional effects when used on poop blocks.

✦Urine – Right-click a toilet with a glass bottle to obtain a urine bottle; feed it to a chicken to get a water bottle back.

✦Compost Urn – Inject urine into it to obtain fecal liquid; heating fecal liquid yields water.

✦Fecal Liquid – Interacts with other fluids to produce clay, netherrack, and magma blocks.

✦Fecal Incontinence Potion – Brewed from senna leaves, forces affected entities to defecate uncontrollably.

✦Taboo Set & Milos Sword – Weapons and armor crafted from fecal materials.

✦A variety of poop-related food – Expand your survival diet.


# 👨‍🌾 New Professions

♻PoopMaker Villager – Trades poop-related items.

💩 Gourmet Villager – Trades poop-related food and music discs.



# ✈️ Unique Items

✈Toilet Plug – Only obtainable through villager trading; it's a flying mount.

🔗Toilet Linker / Poop Scepter – Connects two toilets across dimensions for instant entity and item transport.

Binding method: Sneak-right-click to bind the first toilet, then (without sneaking) right-click to bind the second.



# 🔄 Version Support

Fabric versions are no longer supported.

NeoForge 1.21.1 is actively maintained.



# 📦 Modpack Usage

You are free to include this mod in any modpack without asking for permission.
